    He made his film debut in a bit part in the 1981 film Endless Love, followed by a major supporting role as a crazed military academy student in Taps later that year. Cruise was originally supposed to appear as a background actor but his role was expanded after impressing director Harold Becker.

    About

    Description

    Thomas Cruise Mapother IV is an American actor and film producer. Regarded as a Hollywood icon, he has received various accolades, including an Honorary Palme d'Or, an Academy Honorary Award, and three Golden Globes, in addition to nominations for four competitive Academy Awards. Wikipedia
    Born: July 3, 1962 (age 63 years), Syracuse, New York, United States
    Spouse: Katie Holmes (m. 2006–2012), Nicole Kidman (m. 1990–2001), Mimi Rogers (m. 1987–1990)
    Upcoming movie: Digger
    Children: Suri Noelle, Connor Cruise, Isabella Jane Cruise
    Height: 1.7 m
    Parents: Thomas Mapother III, Mary Lee Pfeiffer
    Siblings: Marian Mapother, Cass Mapother, Lee Ann Mapother
